The lunch talks of the Swedish Society of Behavioural Medicine are held at universities across Sweden. You are warmly welcome to join either on site or online. The talks are free of charge.

[Join via Zoom](https://umu.zoom.us/j/6429428957){.btn-sbf} [Contact us](contact.qmd){.btn-sbf .btn-outline}
